scientific_question: Can a scope-adaptive fixed-width high-byte code with one reserved literal escape remove the bitmap overhead and produce a bit-exact FP16 Muon state below 14 bits/coordinate?

theory.representation: Store the low byte verbatim. For scope s use K_s=2^k_s codes: K_s-1 codes identify common high-byte values and the last code means that the exact literal high byte follows in the block-local exception stream.
theory.cost: For scope s, the coordinate cost is 8+k_s+8*p_escape,s bits, plus K_s-1 dictionary bytes and 32-bit exception offsets per block. There is no exception bitmap.
theory.scope_adaptation: The measured c_fc high byte is substantially lower entropy and has far fewer K=16 exceptions than c_proj. Independent k_fc and k_proj avoid paying a wide index for every c_fc coordinate.
theory.parallel_decode: A lane reads one fixed-width code. Common values are direct table lookups. Escape lanes use block-local ballot/popcount to locate their literal byte. No serial entropy state or prefix-code walk is required.
non_claims: This terminal-state audit does not establish dictionary stability through optimizer updates.
Reference CPU timings do not establish CUDA performance.
A capacity pass authorizes only an exact codec prototype and MFU gate, never a language-model loss replay.

frozen_candidates.common_entries: K-1; code K-1 is always the literal escape.
frozen_candidates.tie_breaking: Equal-count common high bytes are ordered by ascending uint8 value.
frozen_candidates.packing: Low bytes, fixed-width codes, exception literals, dictionaries, block offsets, descriptors, and header are all counted; each matrix stream is byte-aligned.

measurements: exact bytes and bits/coordinate for every frozen (K_fc,K_proj,B,granularity) tuple
c_fc and c_proj escape fractions and all byte components
bit-exact source and decoded word-stream SHA-256
reference encode/decode wall time as a correctness diagnostic

decision_gate.primary_selection: Minimum bytes; ties choose larger B, then coarser granularity, then smaller K_fc+K_proj.
decision_gate.performance_control: Among passes within 2% of primary bytes, choose largest B, then coarsest granularity, then smallest K_fc+K_proj.
decision_gate.if_pass: Implement only primary and distinct performance-control CUDA paths; require randomized/special/checkpoint/resume bit-exact tests and exact-config encode-plus-decode MFU >=20%. Do not run a loss endpoint.
decision_gate.if_fail: Reject fixed-width table codecs and preregister a block-independent finite-state entropy or shared temporal predictor audit; do not broaden table sizes post hoc.

execution_policy.implementation_before_execution: Commit this plan, add a read-only exact capacity audit with focused tests, Git-sync, and verify frozen source hashes.
execution_policy.monitoring: Expected below five minutes and foreground-polled; attach a terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog only if observed above five minutes.
execution_policy.resource_policy: CPU/host RAM only; GPU0 remains free.
